HelloStartupWhy.heading: Why we built this
HelloStartupWhy.description: Early-stage businesses shouldn't have to choose between good customer support and their runway. Hello Free for Startups gives qualifying US startups the same platform growing companies pay for — at zero cost — so you can deliver professional, multi-channel support from day one.

HelloStartupEligibility.heading: Eligibility — you must meet all of these
HelloStartupEligibility.description: To keep this program focused on genuine early-stage businesses, your business qualifies only if it meets every condition below.

cards.title: Registered US business
cards.description: A business entity registered in the United States — LLC, C-Corp, S-Corp, Partnership, or registered Sole Proprietorship. Unregistered individuals are not eligible.

cards.title: Revenue below $50,000
cards.description: Your annual revenue is below $50,000, as evidenced by your tax return or verified financial statements.

cards.title: Verified financial statements
cards.description: A valid financial statement or tax return for the most recent financial year, plus proof of registration and a signed self-declaration.

cards.title: One account per business
cards.description: Only one free Startup account per registered entity. Splitting your business to stay within limits will disqualify you.

HelloStartupPlan.heading: What's included in your free plan
HelloStartupPlan.subheading: The Free Startup Plan gives you full access to Hello — capped at the limits below. Stay within them and you pay nothing.
HelloStartupPlan.action_badge: What you get — and the limits
HelloStartupPlan.notice: Cross any of these caps and you'll simply be invited to upgrade to a paid plan — your account and data continue uninterrupted.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Fill the form and upload your financial statements and registration proof.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our team verifies your documents and eligibility, typically within a few business days.

steps.title: Activation
steps.description: Once approved, your free Startup account is switched on.

steps.title: Annual review
steps.description: We re-confirm eligibility each year and help you transition smoothly as you grow.

HelloStartupGrow.heading: When you grow, you keep everything
HelloStartupGrow.description: Crossing $50,000 revenue is a good problem. When you do, your data, conversations and setup stay exactly as they are — you just move to a paid Hello plan. No migration, no disruption.

items.question: Is it genuinely free?
items.answer: Yes — within the usage limits above, for as long as you remain eligible.

items.question: Why do you need financial statements?
items.answer: Verified financial statements help us verify revenue objectively and ensure this initiative supports early-stage startups that need it most.

items.question: What if I exceed the ticket or agent limit?
items.answer: If you cross the limits, you will simply be invited to upgrade to a paid Hello plan. Your account and data will continue completely uninterrupted.

items.question: What happens at annual review if I've grown?
items.answer: Crossing $50,000 revenue is great news! We will help you smoothly transition to a regular paid plan with zero migration hassle and no downtime.

items.question: Can access be withdrawn?
items.answer: Access remains active as long as you remain eligible and adhere to fair use policies. If eligibility terms are violated, access may be revoked after prior notice.
